trap.label: require / take advantage of
trap.wrong: The app requires of a phone. You are required register. Take advantage from this offer.
trap.right: The app requires a phone. You are required to register. Take advantage of this offer.
trap.why: Em português “exige um celular”, “aproveite esta oferta” usam estruturas diferentes. Em inglês require é transitivo direto; be required to + verbo; take advantage of.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com require: “You need a passport.” (Entry requires...)
Reescreva: “The law obliges you to register.” (required)
Reescreva no passado: “Take advantage of the offer.” (We)
rewrite.answer: We took advantage of the offer.
